name: Fonn Zunich
description: A character present at Aul House who was removed to the Undercity and later investigated Zuza Uldossa's murder.

description_citations.text: "Tin Street Market". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bayul passes his gem to Fonn Zunich before dying.
timeline.quote: Bayul ultimately passed his gem to his ledev guardian Fonn Zunich before dying

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Boros Legion members are revealed to be Lupul and attack Fonn and her allies, who narrowly escape.
timeline.quote: Fonn and her allies narrowly escaped their attack

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fonn places Bayul's gem on her dying wolf Biracazir, reviving the Chorus and Mat'Selesnya, whose power destroys the shapeshifters and leaves Szadek a charred husk.
timeline.quote: she placed it on her mortally wounded wolf , Biracazir .

citation.text: "Decamillennial", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists attack Fonn and her scouts, knocking Fonn out and taking Myc and the others.
timeline.quote: Fonn and her scouts (her son being among them) are attacked by a group of Rakdos cultists.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Chapter 4". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fonn brings Myc to Jarad, now a zombie; Myc decides to become a Golgari hunter.
timeline.quote: Fonn brings her son to his father, who used necromancy to become a zombie.

citation.text: "Dissension (novel)", section "Epilogue". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jarad saves Fonn from Savra's assassination plot against Bayul.
timeline.quote: Fonn was saved by the bounty hunter Jarad

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fonn brings Bayul to the mortuary with Agrus Kos; Bayul gives her the communication gem.
timeline.quote: Bayul woke just long enough to give his instructions to Fonn

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Savra's quietmen abduct Fonn and Savra rips off her hand when she refuses to give up the gem.
timeline.quote: the matka ripped her whole hand off.

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fonn learns the truth about her father's death from Kos.
timeline.quote: She learned that truth from Kos after the Decamillennial disaster

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Fonn and Jarad marry and have a son.
timeline.quote: The pair married, and stayed together for some time

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rakdos cultists waylay Fonn's training group; Jarad and Fonn accidentally bind Myc's mind to the demon.
timeline.quote: accidentally binding Myc's mind with the demon 's.

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Myc leaves his mother to learn the ways of the Golgari.
timeline.quote: Myc decided to leave his mother

citation.text: "Fonn Zunich", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Izolda's Rakdos cultists use Myc's blood to awaken Rakdos; his parents interrupt, Myc bonds with the demon, and Rakdos rampages across Ravnica City.
timeline.quote: allowing the demon to rampage across Ravnica City.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The remaining nephilim are stopped by Fonn's Ledev team and Rakdos; Rakdos and Kraj fight to a draw and both are incapacitated; Rakdos returns to his lava pit and Svogthir and Momir Vig are killed.

citation.text: "The Dissension", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The goblin assassin detonates a bomb at Aul House, killing himself, Bayul and Borca; Kos survives and Fonn is removed to the Undercity by Jarad vod Savo.
timeline.quote: The goblin assassin then detonated a bomb, killing himself, Bayul, and Borca in the blast.

citation.text: "Tin Street Market", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Twelve years later Fonn investigates the murder of shop owner Zuza Uldossa, whose body is examined by Dr. Helligan, a Lupul in disguise.
timeline.quote: Fonn investigated another murder on the street, this time of shop owner Zuza Uldossa
